title: The Rights of Children upon Their Parents in Islam

text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children upon their parents in Islam, mentioning Prophetic hadiths that urge good tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and treating them with kindness and justice. It also highlights the importance of avoiding harshness and violence in tarbiyah, and the necessity of instilling religious and moral values in the hearts of children.
